status: approved by the owner on 2026-10-17 (recommended by a Fable review); applies from formal R2 onward

base.unchanged: R0.1 stays as is: every tolerance value, reference, fixture and the R1 pass condition. R0.2 only adds the rules below.

update_comparison.applies_to: Rust training against a Python/Torch reference for the full model: formal R2 (one update, eight updates, mature-state import) and later
gates: loss at every update: normalized_loss for update 1, eight_step_loss for later updates
gradients of all trainable tensors at every update: R0.1 gradient rule (elementwise atol/rtol and the global relative L2 or zero-reference rule over all tensors together)

parameters and first/second moments after an update: the R0.1 kind for that update, compared only on elements whose reference gradient magnitude is at least K*eps at every update up to and including the compared one
same-backend resume: byte-exact, unchanged from R0.1
update_comparison.eps: the AdamW eps of the recipe (1e-8)
update_comparison.rationale: AdamW divides by sqrt(v)+eps, so the first-update sensitivity of a parameter to its gradient is lr*eps/(|g|+eps)^2; it is about lr/eps where |g| is near eps and small where |g| >= 10*eps. The threshold follows from this formula, not from fitting results.
records_required: the number, tensor names and indices of excluded elements per compared update
post-update forward outputs (normalized quantiles) compared against the reference, recorded but not a gate, because elements with near-zero or tie gradients feed them directly
update_comparison.stop_rule: if more than 10% of elements are excluded at any compared update on real data, stop and investigate before accepting the result

evidence.setup: R2P step 4 artificial fixture, float32 vs float64 Torch as a proxy for Rust-float32 vs Torch-float32

results.mature_import_64_updates_one_update: 0 failing without exclusion (max 7.2e-7 against atol 1e-6); 0 failing with K=10

R1_gate_for_formal_R2.R1_status: unchanged: one cumulative intermediate element (train-last/blocks.1/index3450) is still unmet; R1 is not declared passed
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.formal_R2_entry: R1 final outputs (normalized and physical quantiles, all 7 fixed cases) within R0.1, and all 385 same-input local comparisons within R0.1
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.intermediate_condition: the cumulative intermediate comparison remains required and recorded for every run, as a diagnostic; it no longer blocks formal R2
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.rationale: the unmet difference (2.74e-6 against a limit of 2.57e-6 on a value of 0.028) comes from upstream accumulation with zero same-input local difference, is of the same order as the training tolerances (gradient atol 2e-5, eight-update parameter atol 3e-6), and no principled general fix exists; keeping it as a gate would stop the practical validation indefinitely
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.not_changed: no element is excluded, no tolerance is widened, no reference is regenerated, and product equivalence is still judged separately
